name: frontend-slides-pptx
description: Create polished HTML slides and export supported elements to editable PowerPoint.

interface.shortDescription: Design slides in HTML and export supported elements to editable PPTX
interface.longDescription: Keeps frontend-style slide design while adding a measured DOM schema, native PPTX export, and PPTX-to-HTML recovery for supported elements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create or revise a fixed-stage HTML presentation, then export its supported elements to an editable PowerPoint and preserve stable IDs for future round trips.
